g.text: Configure an assignment and pick a mode [FR-1, FR-6]
Mode is per assignment and changeable later.
It lives in the database, so switching modes
does not require re-uploading the autograder
Rough guidance for the instructor guide:
IMMEDIATE suits small classes and formative
work where fast feedback is the point.
NIGHTLY suits large classes, deadline spikes,
[for each method or class to grade]
over token spend. ON_FAILURE is the default and
means correct code costs nothing. ALWAYS is for
style or design feedback no test can detect.
NEVER is for targets graded purely by tests.
AUTOGRADER delegates to the instructor's own
This is the only lever. It is applied during
the submission autograder run, and there is no
post-hoc path to request feedback on a
submission that has already been AI-graded.

harder than before. In nightly mode an
